name: Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only)
description: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on the selection's box, on your own ComfyUI: generated skin, hair and fabric look less waxy. Needs a ComfyUI on Windows with an RTX 30, 40 or 50 card and the community node pack ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer with its runtime, which you install there yourself (Help › Manual › Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only)); Scumble ships none of it. The box goes out at its own size, without a fill or the reference layers, and comes back as a layer over it. Preset L or M picks the DLSS model; style and strength: the row Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only) in the Generate pane.
